Visitors to World War II Days engage in elaborate 1940s displays in historical buildings on the museum’s 148-acre campus, which becomes the back drop of a European village during World War II. blurb: History and stories of the past come to life at the award-winning Midway Village Museum in Rockford, Illinois. We invite you to visit and explore Midwestern life as it was during the early 1900s through artifacts, exhibits, special events and tours.
